limits: This is an observed configure-time import and native-linkage inventory on macOS, not a clean source build or a Node binary build attestation.
The capture instrument was supplied through PYTHONPATH and excluded from imported-file hashes; user site-packages were present on sys.path but no imported module origin resolved there.
Python extension linkage is captured through direct install names and recursively resolved Python.framework dylibs. OS-provided dependencies are named but not content-hashed.
No compiler build was run; no Node objects, archives or binary were produced. No APK, phone, Host, or Keychain was operated.

This does not close Node/NDK/Gradle/Android platform licensing or SBOM, legal review, V8 signal-chain review, product integration/signing, or 16 KB physical-device execution. A3.6 and A4.7 remain open.

nativeRuntimeClosure.method: otool -L on the interpreter and all imported native extensions; recursively inspected existing dependencies within the Python 3.15 framework. macOS system libraries are recorded by install name but not hashed because they are OS-provided.
